Bug ID: BUG-101
Title: Application crashes during image upload
Priority: Critical
Severity: Critical
Component: Image Upload Service
Description:
The application crashes whenever a user uploads an image larger than 50 MB. As a result, users
are unable to complete the upload process.
Error Log:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
at java.io.FileInputStream.read(FileInputStream.java:255)
at com.app.upload.ImageUploadService.upload(ImageUploadService.java:87)
Expected Result:
The image should be uploaded successfully without affecting the application.
Actual Result:
The application crashes and the upload fails.
